UIKit is part of 3 of my public repositories, from 2018 to 2021.

What it was for: [Knowledge](@/projects/knowledge.md) (2) and [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [ReadingPhoneNumbersInRealTime](@/work/readingphonenumbersinrealtime.md); [MinervaEye](@/work/minervaeye.md): iOS application for book management; [bc-apple](@/work/bc-apple.md): BlockCollider Apple Apps.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses UIKit: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links UIKit to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
